_comment: Copy to ~/.config/msx/config.json on the machine that posts. Never commit the real file.

auto_onboard._comment: A report from a client with no mapping: build the mapping from the client's own wages journals in Xero. Every code proven -> the client starts in mode_when_complete (draft = a DRAFT journal to approve in Xero); any gap -> shadow plus a hold naming it.

engine._comment: The practice's own Xero app (Digivolve Practice API, Azure Function App digivolve-xero) holds the Xero token for every client org. This machine only holds an Entra app secret and the route's function key, entered once with `msx auth login`.

xero._direct_comment: Everything below is only used when backend is 'direct' (a PKCE app and a Xero token on this machine).

apps._comment: Optional extra PKCE apps when one app's connection cap is reached; a client mapping selects one with xero.app.

graph._comment: Optional channel of last resort when Missive fails: an Entra app with Application Mail.Send (the practice's existing mailer app).
